justification: Javonte put the ball on the carpet last week in a game we lost, and I don't care that he's my RB1 or that the kid's got twenty points sitting on some sheet somewhere — that's the code, he sits one week, no discussion, we don't bring it up again after today. Jonah Coleman steps in and earns the carry, not inherits it. Breece Hall and Chase Brown keep doing the dirty work in the backfield, nobody's touching their chairs. Cooper's got a Questionable next to his name and he's starting anyway — a kid who suits up hurt is worth more to me than a healthy body who's never been tested, that's just respect. Malik Washington's been getting touched every week down in Miami and he walks back into WR2 over Bernard, who's gone quiet since I brought him in — a ghost don't eat at my table. Lawrence stays under center over Nix, he threw for 350 and three scores last week for six bucks, that's not a projection, that's a receipt, and Murray's Out so that conversation's over before it starts. LaPorta, Bates, and the Buffalo defense ride as-is, they haven't done anything to lose their spot. We're 2-8 and I know it better than anybody writing about it in that rag, but I don't lose on purpose and I don't panic — I just stopped carrying a fumble into Sunday.
